answer: Nobody is waved through free: 25 stamped dockets, each costing £14 to have checked is the price, and the lagoon never covers it twice. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. The desk only stamps a name that carries Blazonbound gules valuer torse writ, and the stamp itself rests on a writ gules valuers sign after herald office audits. Every onyx is counted once. The tally keeps crystal.
